notes: housedoctor.com is a multi-brand Shopify storefront (House Doctor + sister brands Meraki/Nicolas Vahe/byNORD on the same domain, per prior Home-Decor pass). Site renders in English by default at /en-int; no login wall on the consumer storefront (separate B2B portal exists at retailer.societyoflifestyle.com but is not needed to browse/see counts here). No robots.txt Claude-specific disallow. Checked: full header mega-menu (178 distinct nav links harvested from the SSR homepage HTML, spanning all type-tree and room-tree categories) - no Bestsellers/Best Sellers/Top Sellers/Most Popular/Customer Favorites/Trending nav item anywhere. Footer - no such link either (only Contact/FAQ/Shipping/Returns/legal/B2B-login/Career/Press/sister-brand links). Full /collections.json enumeration (271 collections across 2 pages) grepped for best/sell/sale/clearance/outlet/new/sold/popular/trend/favorit - no bestseller-named collection exists at all. Shopify's own search-suggest API (/search/suggest.json) queried for 'bestseller', 'best seller', 'popular', 'top seller', 'trending', and Danish 'bestsellere'/'populaer' - zero collection results for all of them. It also surfaced two candidates that needed real inspection: (1) 'Favourites' (/en-int/collections/favourites) - this is NOT a real Shopify collection; it's an embedded Clerk.io personalisation widget (data-template='@category-page-popular', i.e. the site's own 'Popular' concept) with 0 native products.json entries. Rendered it live in Chrome (not just HTTP/Playwright, since the widget is consent/JS-gated) and it explicitly displays 'Filter By / 0 Product' - confirmed empty, so dropped per 'drop zero-product listings'. (2) 'Cille Fjord's House Doctor favourites' (/en-int/collections/cille-fjord-favourites, 16 products, all House Doctor branded, exhaustively paginated) - opened live: page copy reads 'AW26 favourites selected by @cillefjord ... To celebrate the new AW26 collection, Cille has selected her latest House Doctor favourites'. This is an influencer/editorial curation tied to a seasonal launch, not the site's own best-selling/most-popular merchandising concept - excluded per the editorial/inspiration-page exclusion in section 3, not a MANUAL REVIEW case (the page itself states its curatorial nature plainly). A second Meraki-branded twin 'Cille Fjord's Meraki favourites' exists but Meraki is out of scope (separate sister-brand product line, excluded consistent with the prior Home-Decor pass for this company). No /pages/ page (39 total, enumerated via pages.json) is bestseller-themed either. Conclusion: no genuine Bestsellers-type PLP exists on this site at present.
